bounded_host_request.command:
set -e
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$pg")" = true
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atc "
SELECT 'CURSOR='||COALESCE(MAX(last_update_id)::text,'NONE') FROM videobot_poll_cursor;
SELECT 'RECENT='||update_id||':'||status||':'||COALESCE(handled::text,'NULL')
FROM videobot_webhook_updates ORDER BY update_id DESC LIMIT 8;
SELECT 'PENDING='||COUNT(*) FROM videobot_webhook_updates WHERE status<>'completed';
"
echo TELEGRAM_RECEIPT_DB_READ=PASS
